title: Unused Field
description:
Unused-code rule — fields with no usage anywhere: not read, displayed, set, found, sorted, imported, exported or summarized, and not used as the source of a value list or as a break field. Every link role the catalog counts as where-used is a usage. Findings in files exported without DDR info are marked unverified.

Based on the PMD rule UnusedPrivateField — https://docs.pmd-code.org/latest/pmd_rules_java_bestpractices.html#unusedprivatefield
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Unused fields bloat tables and confuse data models.
rule.remediation: Confirm no external / SQL usage, then delete the field. In a file exported without DDR info formula references are missing, so its findings are marked unverified — export it again with DDR info before deleting.
